properties.title: total_supply_equals_sum_of_balances
properties.description: totalSupply always equals the sum of balanceOf over all accounts.

properties.title: shares_backed_by_pot_pie
properties.description: The normalized Pot balance held by SavingsDai (pot.pie(sDAI)) is always at least totalSupply, so every outstanding share is backed by one unit of pie.

properties.title: zero_and_self_hold_no_shares
properties.description: The zero address and the SavingsDai contract itself never hold shares.

properties.title: transfer_moves_exact_amount
properties.description: A successful transfer(to, v) decreases the caller's balance by v and increases to's balance by v (no change when to == caller), leaves every other balance and totalSupply unchanged, and returns true.

properties.title: transfer_revert_conditions
properties.description: transfer(to, v) (with no ETH sent) reverts if and only if to is the zero address, to is SavingsDai, or the caller's balance is below v.

properties.title: transferFrom_moves_exact_amount_and_spends_allowance
properties.description: A successful transferFrom(from, to, v) moves exactly v from from to to, leaves totalSupply unchanged, and if the caller is not from and the allowance is finite, decreases allowance[from][caller] by exactly v; an infinite allowance or a self-spend leaves the allowance unchanged.

properties.title: transferFrom_revert_conditions
properties.description: transferFrom(from, to, v) (no ETH) reverts if and only if to is zero or SavingsDai, from's balance is below v, or the caller is not from and has a finite allowance below v.

properties.title: approve_and_allowance_adjustments_are_exact
properties.description: approve sets allowance[caller][spender] to exactly the value; increaseAllowance adds exactly the value (reverting on overflow); decreaseAllowance subtracts exactly the value and reverts iff it exceeds the current allowance. None of them change any balance or other allowance.

properties.title: balance_decrease_requires_owner_or_allowance
properties.description: For any SavingsDai method, if an account's share balance decreases by d and the caller is not that account, the caller held an allowance of at least d from that account beforehand.

properties.title: allowance_changes_only_by_authorized_actions
properties.description: allowance[owner][spender] can increase only through a call by owner (approve/increaseAllowance) or a permit for owner; it can decrease only when the caller is owner or spender, or via permit.

properties.title: third_party_balances_unaffected
properties.description: No SavingsDai method changes the share balance of an account that is neither the caller nor an address argument of the call (from/to/receiver/owner).

properties.title: total_supply_changes_only_via_vault_operations
properties.description: totalSupply increases only through deposit/mint and decreases only through withdraw/redeem; ERC20 and permit methods never change it.

properties.title: deposit_accounting
properties.description: A successful deposit(assets, receiver) returns shares = assets*RAY/chi with chi the Pot accumulator after drip, increases receiver's balance and totalSupply by exactly shares, moves exactly assets DAI from the caller, and increases SavingsDai's pie by exactly shares.

properties.title: mint_accounting
properties.description: A successful mint(shares, receiver) returns assets = ceil(shares*chi/RAY), increases receiver's balance and totalSupply by exactly shares, and moves exactly assets DAI from the caller.

properties.title: withdraw_accounting
properties.description: A successful withdraw(assets, receiver, owner) burns shares = ceil(assets*RAY/chi) from owner, decreases totalSupply and SavingsDai's pie by shares, and credits receiver with exactly assets DAI.

properties.title: redeem_accounting
properties.description: A successful redeem(shares, receiver, owner) burns exactly shares from owner, decreases totalSupply and SavingsDai's pie by shares, returns assets = floor(shares*chi/RAY) and credits receiver with exactly assets DAI.

properties.title: withdraw_redeem_require_authorization
properties.description: withdraw/redeem by a caller other than owner succeed only if allowance[owner][caller] covers the burned shares, and spend exactly that many shares of a finite allowance.

properties.title: invalid_receiver_rejected
properties.description: deposit and mint revert when the receiver is the zero address or SavingsDai itself.

properties.title: previews_match_operations
properties.description: In the same state and block, previewDeposit/previewMint/previewWithdraw/previewRedeem return exactly what deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem then return, even when the Pot has not been dripped.

properties.title: conversions_round_in_vault_favor
properties.description: previewMint(s) >= convertToAssets(s) and previewWithdraw(a) >= convertToShares(a): operations where the user specifies the output never charge less than the exact conversion.

properties.title: max_functions_consistent
properties.description: maxRedeem(owner) equals owner's share balance and maxWithdraw(owner) equals convertToAssets of that balance; maxDeposit and maxMint are unbounded.

properties.title: no_profit_from_deposit_redeem_roundtrip
properties.description: Rounding cannot be exploited: within one block, depositing assets and immediately redeeming the received shares never returns more DAI than deposited, and minting shares then withdrawing the paid assets never needs fewer shares than minted.

properties.title: share_price_never_decreases
properties.description: No SavingsDai operation decreases the Pot rate accumulator chi, so the DAI value of a share (convertToAssets) cannot be lowered by any user action.

properties.title: vault_ops_do_not_affect_other_holders
properties.description: deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem do not change the share balance of any account other than the receiver (deposit/mint) or owner (withdraw/redeem), so one user cannot dilute or drain another.

properties.title: referral_overloads_equivalent
properties.description: deposit(assets, receiver, referral) and mint(shares, receiver, referral) behave exactly like deposit(assets, receiver) and mint(shares, receiver): same revert behaviour, same return value and same resulting state, for every referral code. (Pass 3: the accounting/preview rules only covered the two-argument overloads.)

properties.title: conversions_and_previews_monotonic
properties.description: In a fixed state and block, convertToShares, convertToAssets and the four previews are non-decreasing in their input amount, and the actual deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem outputs are too (more assets never buy fewer shares, more shares never redeem for fewer assets, withdrawing more never burns fewer shares, minting more never costs fewer assets).

properties.title: no_gain_from_splitting_operations
properties.description: Splitting one operation into two in the same block never benefits the user: two deposits of a and b mint at most the shares of one deposit of a+b; two redeems of s and t pay at most the assets of one redeem of s+t; two mints of s and t cost at least one mint of s+t; two withdraws of a and b burn at least the shares of one withdraw of a+b.

properties.title: exit_rejects_invalid_receiver
properties.description: withdraw and redeem revert when the receiver is address(0), mirroring deposit/mint's receiver check, so a user cannot burn the withdrawn DAI by mistake (mainnet DAI's mint accepts address(0)).

expected_fail.detail: withdraw/redeem with receiver == address(0) succeed. SavingsDai._burn never checks the receiver; it calls DaiJoin.exit(address(0), assets), which calls Dai.mint(address(0), assets), and mainnet DAI's mint accepts address(0). The DAI is credited to address(0), so nobody can spend it (it is effectively burned) while the owner's shares are burned. Nothing on this path depends on chi, so the zero-receiver path is reachable for any chi value. The prover CEXs are the zero-amount calls withdraw(0, 0, owner) / redeem(0, 0, owner). For illustration only, the satisfy witness exitToZeroReceiverWitness (VERIFIED) shows a positive amount, from a state where the structural invariants hold and chi >= RAY (its chi is ~5.9e76, not a realistic value): caller 0x2380 with allowance spends 1 share of owner 0x8200 in withdraw(12, address(0), 0x8200), and Dai.balanceOf(0) goes 7 -> 19. Impact: a user-error footgun that loses the withdrawn DAI. It is asymmetric with deposit/mint, which reject receiver 0 and SavingsDai (invalidReceiverRejected). ERC-4626 does not mandate the check, so this is a low-severity robustness/UX finding, not a theft vector: only the owner or an approved spender can trigger it, and only to their own loss. Out of this property's scope: receiver == SavingsDai is a second unrecoverable sink (DAI minted to sDAI cannot be moved out by any sDAI function).

properties.title: permit_revert_on_expired_or_zero_owner
properties.description: permit reverts if block.timestamp > deadline or owner is the zero address.

properties.title: permit_effects
properties.description: A successful permit(owner, spender, value, ...) sets allowance[owner][spender] to exactly value, increments nonces[owner] by exactly one, and changes no other allowance, nonce or balance.

properties.title: nonces_only_increase_via_permit
properties.description: For any SavingsDai method, nonces never decrease; a nonce changes only by a successful permit for that owner, and then by exactly one.

properties.title: permit_signature_forms_equivalent
properties.description: permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, v, r, s) behaves exactly like permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, abi.encodePacked(r, s, v)): same revert behaviour and same resulting allowance and nonce.

properties.title: setup_approvals_preserved
properties.description: No SavingsDai method revokes sDAI's Vat hope for DaiJoin or Pot, or lowers its DAI allowance to DaiJoin below type(uint256).max (both set up by the constructor).

properties.title: owner_can_always_redeem
properties.description: Given a live Maker system (DaiJoin.live == 1, sDAI's constructor approvals in place, Pot authorised on the Vat, Pot's Vat balance covering sDAI's pie, dsr >= RAY), an owner's redeem of their whole balance and withdraw of maxWithdraw never revert.

properties.title: redeem_does_not_depend_on_drip
properties.description: Probe: owners can redeem even when Pot.drip would revert (e.g. dsr < RAY). Expected to expose that sDAI withdrawals require a successful drip whenever rho < now, while direct Pot users can still exit.

expected_fail.detail: With every live-system precondition except dsr >= RAY, an owner's redeem of their full balance reverts: when block.timestamp > Pot.rho, SavingsDai.redeem calls Pot.drip, which computes chi' = rmul(rpow(dsr, now - rho), chi) < chi for dsr < RAY and reverts on the checked `tmp - chi` underflow. CEX (run d239cba6/5aacf739): dsr = 0.5 RAY, rho = 4, now = 7, rpow(dsr,1) < RAY, owner holds 1 share; Pot.drip reverts, so redeem reverts. Impact: if governance ever files dsr < RAY (Pot.file has no lower bound), every sDAI deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem reverts from the next block on, and since Pot.file itself requires rho == now (which needs a successful drip) the rate cannot be corrected except by Pot.cage (which resets dsr = RAY). Direct Pot depositors are not affected: Pot.exit has no rho == now requirement and lets them leave at the last stored chi. sDAI holders' DAI is frozen until cage.
expected_fail.cex_note: Trace values (run d239cba6): dsr=0.5 RAY, rho=4, now=7, rpowG(0.5 RAY,3,RAY)=1 (uninterpreted; real _rpow gives 0.125 RAY), chi~2.4e55. Holds for the real _rpow for every dsr < RAY.

properties.title: deposit_liveness
properties.description: Under the same live-system assumptions, deposit(assets, receiver) by a caller with enough DAI balance and allowance to sDAI does not revert for a valid receiver.

properties.title: vault_never_pays_rounding_from_own_vat_balance
properties.description: No deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem decreases sDAI's own Vat dai balance: rounding dust always accrues to the vault, never drains it.

properties.title: pot_chi_at_least_ray
properties.description: Pot.chi >= RAY in every state reachable from Pot's constructor through any Pot entry point (drip, join, exit, file, cage, rely, deny). Discharges the requirePotChiAtLeastRay / pre_chiAtLeastRay assumptions whose base case was only argued.

properties.title: pot_total_pie_is_sum
properties.description: Pot.Pie equals the sum of Pot.pie over all accounts, from Pot's constructor through every Pot entry point; in particular Pie >= pie[sDAI] (discharges pre_PieCoversSdaiPie).

properties.title: dai_supply_is_sum
properties.description: Dai.totalSupply equals the sum of Dai.balanceOf over all accounts, from Dai's constructor through every Dai entry point; discharges the argued base case of daiSupplyIsSumPreserved and implies balance(a) + balance(b) <= totalSupply for distinct a, b.

properties.title: constructor_wires_maker_system
properties.description: Assuming the constructor's _daiJoin is the scene DaiJoin (A1) and DaiJoin's vat/dai are the scene Vat/Dai (A2), SavingsDai's constructor sets daiJoin/vat/dai to those contracts and pot to the given _pot, and establishes vat.can(sDAI, daiJoin) == 1, vat.can(sDAI, pot) == 1 and dai.allowance(sDAI, daiJoin) == type(uint256).max — the setup the liveness rules assume and setupApprovalsPreserved shows is never undone by SavingsDai methods.

groups.title: Share accounting integrity
groups.description: totalSupply = Σ balances, zero/self hold nothing, every share backed by Pot pie.

groups.title: ERC20 transfer correctness
groups.description: Exact transfers, conserved supply, exact revert conditions.

groups.title: Allowance and authorization
groups.description: Exact, authorised allowance changes; balances fall only by owner or allowance.

groups.title: Isolation between holders
groups.description: No method touches uninvolved accounts; supply changes only via vault operations.

groups.title: Vault deposit/withdraw accounting
groups.description: Exact chi-based pricing and rounding; exact share/pie/DAI movements; receiver validation (deposit/mint enforce it, withdraw/redeem do not — finding F-2); referral overloads identical.

groups.title: ERC4626 view consistency
groups.description: Previews equal operations, rounding favours the vault, max* consistent, all conversions/previews/operations monotonic.

groups.title: Economic attack resistance
groups.description: No round-trip or split-operation gain; share price never lowered; rounding never drains sDAI's Vat balance.

groups.title: Permit (EIP-2612 / ERC-1271)
groups.description: Expired/zero owner rejected, one allowance and one nonce changed, both signature forms equivalent.

groups.title: Maker integration and liveness
groups.description: Constructor wires sDAI to the Maker system and nothing undoes it; owners can always exit and depositors enter in a live system; exits depend on Pot.drip (finding F-1).

groups.title: Maker model invariants
groups.description: Facts about the Maker contracts the vault relies on, proven from their constructors: chi ≥ RAY, Pie = Σ pie, DAI supply = Σ balances.

justification_rules.detail: supports the requirePotChiAtLeastRay trust assumption used in withdrawAccounting and mintWithdrawRoundtripNoProfit

pass 2: proves every state-changing Dai entry point (transfer, transferFrom, mint, burn, approve, push, pull, move, rely, deny, permit) preserves Dai.totalSupply == ghost sum of Dai balances. No vault rule consumes requireDaiSupplyIsSum anymore (the real Dai's checked add makes a wrap revert, not succeed), so it is retained as a proven fact about the DAI model, not as a justification for any bare require.

pass 3: a satisfy rule (VERIFIED = scenario reachable) that witnesses the exitRejectsZeroReceiver finding with a positive amount: withdraw(assets > 0, receiver = address(0)) succeeds, burns > 0 shares from owner and credits Dai.balanceOf(0) with exactly assets. It is not a property rule; VERIFIED here confirms the finding.
